from __future__ import annotations

from tilefoundry import func
from tilefoundry.dsl import Tensor
from tilefoundry.dsl.tf import *  # noqa: F401, F403
from tilefoundry.ir.types.shard import Layout

@func
def gates(
    ba: Tensor[(2, 96), "bf16"],
    log: Tensor[(48,), "f32"],
    bias: Tensor[(48,), "f32"]
):
    v0 = exp(log)  # Tensor[(48,), "f32"]; compute-cost other-ops=special:48@logical,48@total,48@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r192/w192@total,r192/w192@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=memory
    v1 = neg(v0)  # Tensor[(48,), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:48@logical,48@total,48@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r192/w192@total,r192/w192@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v0_2 = 0  # Tensor[(), "i64", Layout((), ()), "umat"]
    v1_2 = 48  # Tensor[(), "i64", Layout((), ()), "umat"]
    v2_2 = ba[:, 48:96]  # Tensor[(2, 48), "bf16"]; compute-cost; traffic traffic=rmem:r16/w0@total,r16/w0@cta; roofline
    v3 = cast(v2_2, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 48), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:96@logical,96@total,96@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r192/w384@total,r192/w384@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v4 = add(v3, bias)  # Tensor[(2, 48), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:96@logical,96@total,96@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r576/w384@total,r576/w384@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v5 = softplus(v4)  # Tensor[(2, 48), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:96@logical,96@total,96@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r384/w384@total,r384/w384@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v6 = mul(v1, v5)  # Tensor[(2, 48), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:96@logical,96@total,96@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r576/w384@total,r576/w384@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v3_2 = 0  # Tensor[(), "i64", Layout((), ()), "umat"]
    v4_2 = 0  # Tensor[(), "i64", Layout((), ()), "umat"]
    v7 = ba[:, 0:48]  # Tensor[(2, 48), "bf16"]; compute-cost; traffic traffic=rmem:r16/w0@total,r16/w0@cta; roofline
    v8 = cast(v7, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 48), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:96@logical,96@total,96@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r192/w384@total,r192/w384@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v9 = sigmoid(v8)  # Tensor[(2, 48), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:96@logical,96@total,96@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r384/w384@total,r384/w384@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    return (v6, v9)
